positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (75.6): 4.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 294 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kallang MRT about 330 m, Geylang Bahru MRT about 790 m; closer than 493 of 662 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Bendemeer Primary School about 1,220 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 190 m), more than 281 of 662 similar developments (the same as 80); nearest hawker centre Blk 17 Upper Boon Keng Market And Food Centre about 210 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 590 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 17 Upper Boon Keng Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 1,110 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,460 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,490 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 220 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 73 new sales and 714 resales (787 purchases); new sales were 9.3% of these purchases. Subsales (28) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 714 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 291 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 714 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 823 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.2%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
